goal: Enable explicit, content-bound amendment of an existing GitHub Initiative's complete pending frontier while preserving historical Child Issues and native ownership, as specified in docs/specs/initiative-amendment.md; retain strict default publication behavior and do not execute or publish the paused Loop plan.

acceptance.assertion: The public publication API and CLI implement the complete amendment invariant in docs/specs/initiative-amendment.spec.md: approved existing open Parent/pending Child updates and new Children converge with exact pending dependencies; historical identity, bytes, terminal evidence and relations are preserved and excluded from execution. Bound content and closed membership make any divergence fail closed with zero or bounded mutations before or after any write, and every amendment outcome is resumable as a whole-batch retry.

docs/agents/issue-tracker.md and plugins/immune-brain/dist/imm-planner.md document the amendment contract, input schema, baseline binding, convergence semantics, fail-closed outcomes and retry action consistent with the runtime implementation, and the strict no-amendment default is unchanged.
Amendment types, validation, and serializiation preserve the strict default publication behavior and all existing tracker guarantees; bun run typecheck passes.
